- [2023/05/26] SPADL has two versions: Regular SPADL (R-SPADL) and Atomic SPADL (A-SPADL).
- [2023/05/26] R-SPADL represents a game as a sequence of on-the-ball actions with twelve attributes.
- [2023/05/26] A-SPADL modifies R-SPADL by removing the result attribute and adding new action types, resulting in eleven attributes.
- [2023/05/26] The paper reviews three approaches for valuing actions in soccer: count-based, expected possession value (EPV), and action-based approaches.
- [2023/05/26] VAEP is an action-based model using SPADL-derived features, initially a binary classification task, later extended to regression.
- [2023/05/26] VERITAS is discussed as a theoretical framework for verifying tree ensembles in sports analytics.
- [2023/05/26] VERITAS addresses verification tasks like Counterfactual Explanations (CE's) and provides bounds on tree ensemble model outputs.
